definitions.pinCurrentA: magnitude (A) of the DC current through the pad
definitions.dir: source = current leaves the part into the net; sink = enters the part from the net; pass = no DC current (|I| < 1 nA)
definitions.netCurrentA: sum of source pin currents on the net (= sum of sink currents, KCL)
definitions.worst: result 'worst' holds, per pin, the maximum current over all scenarios (pins[].scenario names where it occurred)
